premises.text: Wireless power technology can safely and efficiently power multiple devices at a distance.
premises.evidence_span: COTA, a wireless power technology that addresses these challenges and more.

premises.text: COTA technology can deliver one watt of power at a 30-foot distance.
premises.evidence_span: COTA is the only wireless power technology that can deliver one watt of power at a 30-foot distance.

premises.text: COTA can power devices behind walls and around corners without interfering with electronic equipment.
premises.evidence_span: COTA works without line-of-sight, powering devices behind walls and around corners without interfering with electronic equipment.
COTA is inherently safe, as safe as your Wi-Fi hub.

premises.text: COTA can eliminate the need for batteries in devices.
premises.evidence_span: this could forever eliminate that annoying chirp from the mystery smoke detector with a dying battery at 3 in the morning.

premises.text: COTA will be available in several forms, including built into devices and as dongles.
premises.evidence_span: we anticipate that Kota will come to the market in several forms, built into devices and phones, built into standard batteries, and as dongles for current devices.

value.text: Wireless power technology enables a world that's always on and always ready.
value.evidence_span: together we can make a world that's always on, always ready.

notes: Negotiations with electronics manufacturers and capital seeking are excluded as traction.
